headlines.summary: 乘联分会崔东树发文称，锂电池出口价格从2024年14.29万元下降26%，到2025年的11.23万元，降21%。2026年10.5万元降11%，其中7月中国出口的电池均价10.60万元、同比下降3%，4-7月退税降低后的降价幅度较去年的改善明显。近期随着车市生产规模扩大，PPI上行，上游碳酸锂成本上升，锂电池出口价格持续下降，国内电池价格暴涨，车企不造电池的问题严重，车企利润可持续下滑。

headlines.title_en: Cui Dongshu: Recent auto industry profit decline remains significant; mainstream automakers' profitability pressure will intensify sharply
headlines.summary_en: Cui Dongshu of the CPCA wrote that lithium battery export prices fell 26% from 142,900 yuan in 2024 to 112,300 yuan in 2025, down 21%. In 2026, they dropped 11% to 105,000 yuan, with July export battery average price at 106,000 yuan, down 3% YoY; the decline after tax rebate cuts from April to July improved markedly versus last year. Recently, with auto production scale expansion, PPI rising, and upstream lithium carbonate costs up, lithium battery export prices keep falling, while domestic battery prices have surged, worsening automakers' problem of not making batteries, and squeezing auto profit sustainability.

headlines.title: 王毅会见美国驻华大使庞德伟
headlines.summary: 8月26日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在京会见美国驻华大使庞德伟。王毅说，在两国元首领航掌舵下，双方正在推动构建中美建设性战略稳定关系。事实证明，改善发展中美关系，在相互尊重基础上和平共处，进而合作共赢，符合两国人民根本利益，符合国际社会共同期待。同时，中美关系仍面临各种风险挑战。双方应把两国元首达成的重要共识落到实处，聚焦积极议程，妥善管控分歧，为两国高层交往排除干扰、克服障碍，推动中美关系朝着稳定、健康、可持续的方向发展。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi meets with US Ambassador to China Pang Dwei
headlines.summary_en: On August 26, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns in Beijing. Wang Yi said that under the stewardship of the two heads of state, both sides are working to build a constructive and strategically stable China-US relationship. Facts show that improving and developing bilateral ties, coexisting peacefully on the basis of mutual respect, and then achieving win-win cooperation serves the fundamental interests of both peoples and meets the common expectations of the international community. Meanwhile, the relationship still faces various risks and challenges. Both sides should implement the important consensus reached by the heads of state, focus on a positive agenda, properly manage differences, remove interference and overcome obstacles for high-level exchanges, and steer the relationship toward stable, healthy, and sustainable development.

headlines.title: 国家统计局统计科学研究所所长闾海琪解读2025年我国经济发展新动能指数
headlines.summary: 国家统计局统计科学研究所所长闾海琪解读2025年我国经济发展新动能指数，测算显示，2025年转型升级指数为156.8，比上年增长22.7%。战略性新兴产业增加值保持较快增长；高技术制造业增加值比上年增长9.4%，比规模以上工业增加值增速快3.5个百分点，占规模以上工业增加值的比重提高至17.1%；数字产品制造业增加值增长9.3%，占规模以上工业增加值的比重为12.5%；非化石能源占能源消费总量的比重比上年提高约2个百分点；电动汽车、光伏产品、锂电池等“新三样”产品出口规模接近1.3万亿元，增长27.1%，其中电动汽车出口393万辆，增长73.1%。

headlines.title_en: Lü Haiqi, Director of the National Bureau of Statistics Research Institute of Statistical Science, interprets China's 2025 new economic momentum index
headlines.summary_en: Lü Haiqi, director of the NBS Institute of Statistical Science, interpreted China's 2025 new momentum index for economic development. Estimates show the 2025 transformation and upgrading index at 156.8, up 22.7% YoY. Value added of strategic emerging industries maintained rapid growth; high-tech manufacturing value added grew 9.4% YoY, 3.5 percentage points faster than industrial enterprises above designated size, with its share of industrial value added rising to 17.1%; digital product manufacturing value added grew 9.3%, accounting for 12.5% of industrial value added; non-fossil energy share of total energy consumption rose about 2 percentage points YoY; exports of 'new three' items—electric vehicles, photovoltaic products, and lithium batteries—approached 1.3 trillion yuan, up 27.1%, with EV exports at 3.93 million units, up 73.1%.

headlines.title: 商务部回应美考虑对华额外加征7.5%关税
headlines.summary: 商务部27日举行例行新闻发布会，商务部新闻发言人黄玲在回应有关美国政府考虑对自中国进口商品额外加征7.5%关税的提问时说，美方以“产能过剩”为由对包括中国在内的16个经济体发起301调查，将经贸问题政治化，是典型的单边主义、保护主义行为，中方对此坚决反对。我们将继续密切关注并全面评估美方后续举措，并保留采取一切必要措施的权利。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce responds to US consideration of additional 7.5% tariffs on China
headlines.summary_en: At a regular press conference on the 27th, MOFCOM spokesperson Huang Ling, responding to questions about US government considerations of an additional 7.5% tariff on imports from China, said the US launching a Section 301 investigation against 16 economies including China on grounds of 'overcapacity' politicizes economic and trade issues and is typical unilateralism and protectionism, which China firmly opposes. We will continue to closely monitor and comprehensively assess US follow-up measures and reserve the right to take all necessary actions. (Xinhua)

headlines.summary_en: On the morning of August 19, 2026, from 9:50 to 10:20, the Central Treasury Cash Management Office conducted the bidding for the 14th batch of 2026 central treasury cash management commercial bank time deposits. headlines.title_en: All three major A-share indices rise over 1%; semiconductor and computing hardware stocks collectively strengthen
headlines.summary_en: 1, Overall trend: The market strengthened throughout the day, with all three major indices up over 1%, and the STAR 50 Index up nearly 4%. Gainers outnumbered decliners, with about 3,400 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets; turnover reached 2.14 trillion yuan today. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.13%, Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.5%, and ChiNext Index rose 1.71%. 2, Sectors: Computing hardware, semiconductor chips, agriculture, and consumer electronics led gains; banking, baijiu, gas, and film/TV fell. 3, Hot concepts: Computing hardware stocks rallied collectively, with Jin'an Guoji, Hongchang Electronics, and Yangtze Optical Fibre hitting limit-up. Semiconductor chip stocks surged, with Sai MicroElectronics, Bright Power Semiconductor, and Anywave each hitting 20cm limit-up. Agriculture stocks remained active, with Xinsai Co, Xinnong Development, and Wanxiang Denong hitting limit-up. On the downside, photovoltaic equipment fell, with Sungrow down over 12%.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance deploys efforts to advance scientific fiscal management
headlines.summary_en: On August 26, the Ministry of Finance held a fiscal scientific management seminar in Hefei, Anhui, to deeply study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on fiscal work, implement the spirit of the pilot symposium on fiscal scientific management, and study and deploy advancing fiscal scientific management. Finance Minister Lan Fo'an attended and spoke. The meeting held that strengthening fiscal scientific management is an important political task assigned to fiscal departments by the Party Central Committee, and a key measure to enhance fiscal governance efficiency and better safeguard Chinese modernization. headlines.title: CNESA：预计2026至2030年中国新型储能累计装机年均复合增速20.7%-25.5%
headlines.summary: 中关村储能产业技术联盟（CNESA）理事长陈海生在第十一届储能西部论坛上发布数据：预计2026年中国新型储能累计装机规模在保守与理想场景下分别达200.7GW与221.9GW；预计2030年在保守与理想场景下分别达371.2GW与450.7GW。2026至2030年，保守与理想场景的年均复合增长率分别约20.7%和25.5%。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: CNESA: China's new energy storage cumulative installed capacity expected to grow at 20.7%-25.5% compound annual rate from 2026 to 2030
headlines.summary_en: Chen Haisheng, chairman of the China Energy Storage Alliance (CNESA), released data at the 11th Western Energy Storage Forum: In conservative and ideal scenarios, China's cumulative new energy storage installations are expected to reach 200.7 GW and 221.9 GW respectively in 2026; by 2030, 371.2 GW and 450.7 GW respectively. From 2026 to 2030, the average annual compound growth rates in conservative and ideal scenarios are about 20.7% and 25.5% respectively. (Shanghai Securities News)
